teaser.en: A forest liana whose bright red pods split open to show black seeds.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wa msituni ambao maganda yake mekundu angavu hupasuka kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi.

summary.en: Mtsophe is Agelaea pentagyna, a woody climber of forest and thicket. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsophe ni Agelaea pentagyna, mtambaa mgumu wa misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsophe is a woody climber or scrambling shrub. Its leaves are divided into three leaflets, the side ones lopsided. It bears sprays of small white, fragrant flowers, followed by small, hairy, red to orange pods that split along one side to show a black seed partly wrapped in a fleshy aril.
about.sw: Mtsophe ni mtambaa mgumu au kichaka kinachotambaa. Majani yake yamegawanyika katika vijani vitatu, vile vya pembeni vikiwa vimeegemea upande mmoja. Huzaa mashada ya maua madogo meupe yenye harufu nzuri, yanayofuatwa na maganda madogo yenye vinyweleo, mekundu hadi rangi ya chungwa, yanayopasuka upande mmoja kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi iliyofunikwa sehemu na ganda-nyama.

where.en: It grows in forest, forest edges and riverine thicket across tropical Africa and Madagascar, including the coastal forests of Kenya.
where.sw: Huota misituni, pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka-mwitu vizito vya kando ya mito kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki na Madagaska, ikiwemo misitu ya pwani ya Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsophe but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Agelaea pentagyna.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsophe lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Agelaea pentagyna.

reason.en: Rourea, another climber of the same family
reason.sw: Rourea, mtambaa mwingine wa familia hiyohiyo
